name: flow_assemble
description: Join a project's downloaded scene clips in order into one MP4 (local ffmpeg, no credits). Keeps each clip's own sound and can lay a music track and a voiceover on top.

clip_volume.description: Volume of the clips' own sound, 0-1. Lower it (around 0.2-0.3) so a narration sits clearly on top; 1 keeps it as recorded.

clips.description: Absolute clip paths in play order. Default: every scene-NN.mp4 in the project folder (first variant of each).

hold_last_frame.description: Freeze the final frame so a longer voiceover is not cut off.

music.description: Absolute path to a music file; looped and trimmed to the film length.

project.description: Same project name used in flow_generate.

voiceover.description: Absolute path to a voiceover audio file, starts at 0:00.
